sahaServisi.aciklama: Plan work orders and assign them to technicians with drag and drop; technicians close jobs on site with a checklist, photos and the customer's signature.
sahaServisi.aciklamaTeknisyen: Jobs assigned to you. Update the status here when you head out, start and finish.
sahaServisi.aciklamaYonetici: The client's field service records — read-only support view.

yonetici.sec: Select a service company to view.

pano.teknisyenYok: No technicians yet. Add them under Settings › Technicians.
pano.ipucu: Drag a job onto a technician's row and drop it on a time; dropping it here removes the assignment.
pano.cakisma: This technician has another job at the same time
pano.cakismaUyari: Conflict: the technician has another job at the same time ({{no}}).

isler.planIpucu: Turkey time. If left empty, the job waits in the queue.

islerim.bos: No jobs assigned for this day.
islerim.kayitliDegil: You're not on the technician list. Your company manager needs to add you under Field service › Settings › Technicians.

ayrinti.rizasizBilgi: You haven't given location consent: no location is taken at start/finish, the job is still recorded.
ayrinti.konumEklendi: One-time location added to the job.
ayrinti.konumYok: Couldn't get a location; the job was saved without it.
ayrinti.konumVar: Start/finish location recorded (raw coordinates are deleted after {{gun}} days).
ayrinti.konumIndirgendi: Raw location deleted; the record remains at job-address level.
ayrinti.konumAlinmadi: No location was taken for this job.

kontrol.taslak: Draft on this device — will be sent when you're back online

foto.bilgi: All photo metadata (EXIF), including location, is removed on the server. Up to {{sinir}} photos per job.

imza.bilgi: Ask the customer to sign with a finger to confirm the job is done.

riza.ozet: Your location is taken only once, at “Start job” and “Finish job”; there is no continuous tracking.
riza.metin:
In the field service screen, your location is taken ONCE — only when you tap “Start job” or “Finish job”, and only if your browser allows it — and is attached only to that work order. There is no continuous location tracking and no other screen asks for your location.
Purpose: a record that the job was done on site. Raw coordinates are deleted after {{gun}} days; the work order's address remains.
You can withdraw your consent here at any time. If you don't consent or you withdraw, no location is taken and you do your job exactly the same way.
riza.onayla: I've read it and give my explicit consent
riza.geriAlindi: Consent withdrawn; your location will no longer be taken.

musteri.ara: Search name, company, email or phone
musteri.epostaIpucu: Scheduled / on the way / completed updates go to this address.
musteri.silOnay: Delete this customer? If they have job history, their personal data is erased (anonymised).

sablon.sec: Select a template to edit or create a new one.
sablon.varsayilanIpucu: Added automatically to new work orders of this type.
sablon.silOnay: Delete this template? Existing work orders are not affected.

teknisyen.aciklama: Board rows. Up to {{sinir}} active technicians. A technician must be a team member of your account.
teknisyen.davetIpucu: Not in the list? First invite them under Profile › Team and grant the “Field service — technician” permission.
